description: List booking requests left by guests on the organization's public pages, newest first: service, the guest's free-form preferred time, name, phone and status. status='new' is the inbox that still needs a decision — that is the usual call. Omit status to see everything. The reply contains customers' names and phone numbers, so treat it as personal data: use it to serve the request, do not copy it elsewhere.

status.description: Optional filter. Omit to list every request.

name: qrtap_list_bookings
